name: WF6 — Guest Check-in Follow-up Messages [FIXED + Annotated]

parameters.content:
WF6: Automated Guest Welfare Checks
Purpose: Provides 5-star hospitality without manual effort.
Triggers: Runs hourly in the background.
Actions:

Calculates the exact number of hours since a guest checked in.

At exactly 12 hours, sends a "Settling in well?" email.

At exactly 24 hours, sends a "Need any consumables?" email.

Updates the database so guests are never double-texted.

nodes.name: Sticky Note

parameters.content:
⏰ **Hourly Watchdog**
Runs automatically every hour, 24/7. Checks if any guests who checked in recently are due for a welfare message. Kicks off the whole follow-up chain.

nodes.name: 📌 Note: Hourly Trigger

parameters.content:
📆 **Calendar Lookup**
Fetches all Airbnb bookings from the last 48 hours via Google Calendar iCal sync. This gives us the list of guests currently staying who may need a follow-up message.

nodes.name: 📌 Note: Fetch Check-ins

parameters.content:
📋 **Sent Message History**
Reads the Google Sheets DB to check which guests already received the 12h and 24h messages. This is what prevents the same email from being sent twice to the same guest.

nodes.name: 📌 Note: Message History

parameters.content:
📧 **Guest Email Lookup**
Airbnb doesn't share guest emails via iCal. This node reads the 'Guest Email' column that the host manually adds to the DB. Also tries to extract email from the calendar event description as a fallback.

nodes.name: 📌 Note: Email Lookup

parameters.content:
🧠 **Time Calculator & Email Finder**
Core logic node. Calculates exactly how many hours have passed since each guest checked in. Opens the 12h window (hours 12-13) and 24h window (hours 24-25). Skips guests with no email found.

nodes.name: 📌 Note: Hours Calculator

parameters.content:
❓ **Message Gate**
If no guests are in the 12h or 24h timing window right now, the workflow stops here — nothing to do. Only passes through guests who actually need a message sent.

nodes.name: 📌 Note: Message Due Gate

parameters.content:
🔀 **Message Router**
Sends each guest to the correct email — either the 12-hour welfare check ('settling in?') or the 24-hour supplies check ('need more toilet paper?'). Each guest goes to exactly one branch.

nodes.name: 📌 Note: 12h vs 24h Router

parameters.content:
📧 **12-Hour Welfare Email**
Sent exactly 12 hours after check-in (e.g., at 3 AM if guest arrived at 3 PM). A warm, friendly 'Are you settling in well?' message. Sent only ONCE per guest stay.

nodes.name: 📌 Note: 12h Email Send

parameters.content:
📧 **24-Hour Supplies Check Email**
Sent exactly 24 hours after check-in. Asks if the guest has enough toilet paper, hand wash, body wash, etc. Shows the host cares about their comfort. Sent only ONCE per guest.

nodes.name: 📌 Note: 24h Email Send

parameters.content:
💾 **Update 12h Flag Only**
Sets ONLY the '12h Msg Sent' column to TRUE. Critically, this does NOT touch the '24h Msg Sent' flag — ensuring the 24-hour email will still go out later as scheduled.

nodes.name: 📌 Note: Mark 12h Sent

parameters.content:
💾 **Update 24h Flag Only**
Sets ONLY the '24h Msg Sent' column to TRUE. This prevents the 24h email from firing again on the next hourly check. The two flags are updated separately to avoid the bug where both get set at once.

nodes.name: 📌 Note: Mark 24h Sent
